system.description:
Forged in or inspired by the Rebellion. You fight to protect, not to avenge.

  • Guardian's Reach: once per round, when an ally within your reach drops below half HP, you can move up to half your speed to stand beside them, out of turn and without provoking. Until the start of your next turn, attacks against that ally have Disadvantage.
  • Rebellion's Name: Advantage on checks involving civic structures, the Wayfinders, or anyone who answers to the Rebellion's memory — including invoking Zindel's name to open doors, call in debts, or establish standing.
